headline: Japanese Yen Rallies as US Dollar Pulls Back Ahead of Central Bank Meetings
summary: The Japanese yen jumped against a wobbling U.S. dollar, benefiting from a pullback in rate bets ahead of a busy schedule of central bank meetings.
why: Currency movements reflect shifting interest rate differentials and macroeconomic expectations among major economies, impacting international trade and capital flows.

impacts.name: Japanese Yen
impacts.why: Reduced expectations for aggressive Federal Reserve tightening supported a rebound in the yen.

why_moved: Broad dollar weakness and recalibrated monetary policy expectations prompted position adjustments across foreign exchange markets.
